InquelloWorkspaceExecutionPolicy.description: The Workspace execution policy as the desktop main process fetched it from the shared service (`GET /v1/workspaces/{id}/execution-policy`).

execution.description: The policy's `execution` section in its canonical snake_case form, or null when the policy has none (the conservative Inquello default applies). Validated again here; an invalid section is `invalid`.

description: Sets a Task's broader mode. A non-standard mode needs a `human` actor, the confirmation that names its reach exactly, and an effective policy that permits it; otherwise `broad_mode_not_permitted` names the governing rule.

actorKind.description: Supplied by the desktop main process: `human` (the bound principal), `runtime` or `system`.

confirmation.description: The reach statement the person confirmed; null for `standard`.

expectedRevision.description: The Task's broad-mode revision as last read (0 before the first record).

title: InquelloBroadModeSetParams
